en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hammad Bin Usman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It (marriage) is not Prohibited due to breast-feeding except what builds the flesh and the blood’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Fiammad ibn ‘Uthman who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Breastfeeding does not bring unlawfulness unless it grows flesh and blood.’”
